How it works

What happens, week by week

Tap a stage to see exactly what I'll be doing for you.

Before Month 1 · about 7 days. Get set up fast, with no guesswork.

Day 1

Kickoff call

  • Your goals, audience and offer
  • What a "win" means in sales terms
  • Agree platforms, scope and start date
Day 2

Access & assets

  • Share page access or add me as a collaborator
  • Send logos, brand colours and your best past posts
  • Fill a short questionnaire about your ideal client
Days 3-4

Audit & research

  • Profile, content and analytics review
  • Competitor and audience research
  • Find the gap between your page and your sales goal
Days 5-7

Strategy sign-off

  • Positioning, content pillars and goals in one page
  • First calendar outline for you to approve
  • Go-live date confirmed

Foundation. Make it obvious who you help and what you sell.

Week 1

Positioning & profile

  • Rewrite bio, name, highlights and link-in-bio
  • One-sentence offer that people understand
  • Set up your booking or lead link
Week 2

Content system

  • 3 to 4 content pillars and a hooks bank
  • Full 2-week calendar with captions
  • Reusable visual and caption templates
Week 3

Go live

  • Daily posting on your agreed platform
  • Comments and DMs answered in agreed hours
  • First posts with a clear sales call to action
Week 4

Review

  • First monthly report: reach, saves, profile visits, DMs, leads
  • What to keep, stop and test
  • Month 2 calendar approved

Traction. Learn what the right people respond to and start conversations.

Week 5

Double down

  • Repeat your top-performing formats
  • Test 3 new hooks and a short-form video push
  • Cut what is not moving the needle
Week 6

Lead capture

  • A clear call to action on every post
  • DM keywords and reply scripts
  • Lead magnet or booking page connected
Week 7

Social proof

  • Client wins, testimonials and mini case studies
  • Content that answers common objections
  • Story sequences that warm people up
Week 8

Review

  • Report plus lead count
  • Fix the drop-off between views, DMs and calls
  • Month 3 plan approved

Conversion. Turn steady attention into calls and sales.

Week 9

Sales content

  • Offer breakdown posts and FAQ content
  • Before and after, and limited-spot posts
  • Story sequences that lead to a booking
Week 10

Automation

  • DM follow-up flow and auto-replies
  • AI-assisted captions and content repurposing
  • Simple lead tracker with reminders
Week 11

Reach

  • Collaborations and collab posts
  • Targeted outreach to ideal clients
  • Optional paid boost on your best posts
Week 12

Quarter review

  • Results against your sales goals
  • What worked, what to scale
  • Plan for months 4 to 6

Scale. Keep what works and grow it.

Every week

Weekly rhythm

  • Plan and approve the week
  • Daily posting and engagement
  • Quick recap of what moved
Every month

Report & call

  • Monthly report you can actually read
  • Strategy call and next calendar
  • Test one new idea
Every quarter

Strategy reset

  • Review goals and results
  • Add a platform or format if it makes sense
  • Update scope and plan
Anytime

Stay in touch

  • WhatsApp for quick changes
  • Fast replies on launches and promos
  • Flag anything that is not working
